hero.h1: A community of researchers building the future of francophone research
hero.lead: GAMA Institute brings together researchers, students, professors, engineers and industry partners driven by a shared ambition: advancing artificial intelligence and software engineering through world-class research conducted in Quebec and francophone Africa.
